## Handouts — Print Before Session {.unnumbered}

| File | Give when | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `handouts/handout_04_tribunes_orders.html` | Scene 1 — Tribune presents credentials | Let a player break the wax seal aloud |
| `handouts/handout_05_encoded_letter.html` | Scene 2 — players search Tribune's quarters | Hand it folded. Say nothing. Shift 3. |

Open each HTML file in browser, Ctrl+P to print. Standalone — no internet needed after fonts load.
